title: TUP Manila Campus Event Registration System
idea: A campus event registration system for TUP Manila with school email login, capacity-aware event registration, QR check-in, attendance tools, announcements, cancellation, and real-time capacity tracking.
assumptions: TUP Manila users have an institution-managed email domain; the exact domain must be confirmed before production.
An organizer can create and manage events, while a student can register for published events.
The MVP uses Supabase Auth, Postgres, Realtime, and Storage to avoid building custom infrastructure.
QR scanning can use a browser camera library in a later implementation slice; the MVP ticket QR is generated and displayed.
The stated hours are total wall-clock time and the MVP scope applies the kit's 0.6 overhead factor.
open_questions: What exact TUP Manila email domain or domains are allowed?
Which roles may publish events and scan attendance?
Should QR codes be invalidated after first successful check-in?
What retention period applies to attendance and exported files?
